# No Strings Tools

> nostrings.tools is a collection of small, single-purpose web tools (converters, calculators, generators, trackers). Every tool runs entirely in the browser: no login, no tracking, no ads, no server, and it works offline.

Data a tool saves stays in the browser's localStorage on the user's device; the Backup tool exports and restores it as a JSON file. Tools are free to use and each page is self-contained.

## Tools

- [ASCII Table](https://nostrings.tools/ascii-table/): Full ASCII table with decimal, hex, octal, binary and character codes. Search and copy instantly.
- [Aspect Ratio](https://nostrings.tools/aspect-ratio/): Scale dimensions proportionally.
- [Backup](https://nostrings.tools/backup/): Export & restore all app data.
- [Barcode Generator](https://nostrings.tools/barcode-generator/): Generate EAN, UPC, Code 128, Code 39 and IMEI barcodes instantly. Download as image or print.
- [Barcode Scanner](https://nostrings.tools/barcode-scanner/): Scan barcodes online with your camera: EAN, UPC, Code 128 and more. Works in your browser, no app needed.
- [Base Converter](https://nostrings.tools/base-converter/): Convert between binary, hex, octal, decimal instantly. Works offline.
- [Base64](https://nostrings.tools/base64/): Encode or decode Base64 strings instantly. Paste or type, no upload, no server involved.
- [Bet Tracker](https://nostrings.tools/bet-tracker/): Parimutuel pool betting.
- [Big Text](https://nostrings.tools/big-text/): Huge message across the room.
